ORDINANCE LVII OF
2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Bank of
Punjab, Act, 1989
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 26th September, 2002]
No. Legis.13-4/2001, dated
26-9-2002-----The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the- Bank of Punjab (Amendment)
Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at once, except section 3 which shall be
deemed to have come into force with effect from 11th March, 2000.
